title: A Borodin-Okounkov-Geronimo-Case identity for tilted Toeplitz minors
summary: We prove a Fredholm determinantal identity for the tilted Toeplitz minor $$ D_{N}^{ξ,θ}(\varphi):= \det\bigl[(θ_{i}ξ_{j}\varphi)_{i-j}\bigr]_{i,j=1}^{N}, $$ generalizing the Borodin-Okounkov-Geronimo-Case (BOGC) identity to oblique splittings of the Hardy space. The tilts $ξ_{j},θ_{i}$ enter only through an oblique projection that multiplies the trace-class kernel $K$ inside the Fredholm determinant; the BOGC operator $A=I-K$ constructed from $\varphi$ is unchanged.
